newsitem.title: MEXICO: RESEARCH ALERT - Mexico's GCC lowered.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Mexico's GCC lowered.

text.p: Afin brokerage lowered its recommendation on Mexican cement company Grupo Cementos de Chihuahua to sell from hold, Afin said on Thursday.

-- "We believe the strong rise in share prices during the last three months was an overreaction to the company's strengths, such as its financial health or the better pricing environment prevailing in its markets compared to other cement producers," Mexico City analyst Carlos Pena wrote in a report.
-- Although the cement company's revenues exceeded the brokerage's expectations, he said the stock is now overvalued and he was concerned over lower than expected operating margins.
-- Pena predicted cement volumes will rise for the year and prices will move up with inflation.

-- He added that the company is considering building a one million short tonne capacity plant in Colorado state. "If the feasibility study turns out favorably, the construction of the plant could begin in 1998 and have a cost of around $140 million," Pena wrote.
-- GCC's shares had not begin trading early Thursday and closed on Wednesday at 10.02 pesos per share.
